title: Asian cucumber salad

items: 2 medium cucumbers (or 1 English cucumber), sliced ⅛ inch thick

steps: Slice the cucumbers ⅛ inch thick. Toss them with 1 tsp salt in a colander set over a bowl.
Let them sit 10–15 min, until they release water and turn bendy. Shake off the liquid and pat dry with paper towels.
In a medium bowl, whisk the vinegar, sugar, sesame oil, red pepper flakes and garlic until the sugar dissolves.
Add the cucumbers and toss to coat. Taste and add a pinch of sugar if it's too sharp.
tips: Don't skip the salting. It pulls out water so the dressing doesn't get diluted.
For a chunkier salad that soaks up more dressing, smash the cucumbers with the flat of a knife and cut into bite-size pieces instead of slicing.
Add 1 tsp toasted sesame seeds or a splash of soy sauce for more depth.
storage: Best the day it's made. It keeps 1–2 days in the fridge but softens and gets watery. Do not freeze.
